title: Spicy Cajun Chicken & Rice Bowl
description: Smoky chicken breast, basmati rice and charred peppers with a bright lime yogurt drizzle.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and drain well.
Coat the chicken and pepper in the spices, then sear until cooked and lightly charred.
Serve over rice with lime-spiked skyr and coriander.

source.label: Inspired by Good Food spicy Cajun chicken

notes: Rice timed around training refills glycogen fast — save the heavier spice for days without a hard session right after.
